pr_title: Migrate APCUPSD to has entity name
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

This PR adds `translation_key` to all sensors and binary sensors of the APC UPS Daemon integration, adds proper names for them in the `string.json` file, and sets `_attr_has_entity_name` to `True` for all entities within the integration. This makes it follow the recommended entity naming scheme and allows translations. Additionally, all previously ill-formatted `SensorEntityDescription.name`s are all removed.

Tests are also added to ensure such naming scheme is followed in future development. Some of the existing tests are updated due to the change of entity IDs.

[_Learn more about our pull request process._](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/review-process#prs-are-being-drafted-when-changes-are-needed)
Oh I forgot to mention, those things I suggested would better fit in a follow up PR.

Oh by the way, these changes aren't a breaking change. If the unique_id stays the same, the same entity_id is kept. Unless you would setup the integration again.

So these changes only affect new users. (The fact that the name of the entity changes is not considered a breaking change)

> Oh by the way, these changes aren't a breaking change. If the unique_id stays the same, the same entity_id is kept. Unless you would setup the integration again.

Yeah, I was thinking the same (even mentioned this in the breaking changes section) and just wanted to raise awareness for existing users as well (since a lot of them reported such an annoyance of the integration in #86716). 

I'll remove the breaking changes section and leave this up to you folks to decide 😃

Comments addressed, I think we agree some of the changes should be put in follow-up PRs, so the real code change was a removal of `translation_key` for the battery sensor.

Plus, due to the changes in the entity IDs, the tests have to be updated to reference the new entity ID schemes (let me know if there's a better way to query those IDs and I'm happy to update).

review_comments: This one can get the entity category Diagnostic
What does this return?

`statflag` returns a hex value indicating the status of whether it's online, charging, or on battery etc. `status` is the English version of the status (e.g., "ONLINE"). 

We should probably deprecate `statflag` and rely on `status` instead since [it's available in all APC UPSes but `statflag` isn't](https://linux.die.net/man/8/apcaccess#:~:text=apcaccess%20is%20a%20program%20which,installed%2C%20properly%20configured%20and%20running.).
This one could be a timestamp sensor
device class timestamp
timestamp device class

What's the output of this sensor? 

Enum candidate
What does this return?

["Date, time of last transfer to battery since apcupsd startup"](https://linux.die.net/man/8/apcaccess#:~:text=apcaccess%20is%20a%20program%20which,installed%2C%20properly%20configured%20and%20running). We should probably name this "Last transfer to battery date", thoughts?
Would it make sense to deprecate this sensor in the long run since this is already exposed by the Device info?

Sounds good. We never really tried to remove such redundant sensors. Now that most refactors are done and it is in a better state, we should revisit and deprecate some for sure. Will do that in a follow-up PR.
